2608.27309.title: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit
2608.27309.paper_summary: Audits of LLM judges certify a bias by contrasting matched conditions, and the strongest designs difference twice: a within-item contrast between two candidate responses, differenced again across a manipulated attribute, read off a bounded rating scale. We show that this endpoint is not identified on the scale that reports it. Each term of the double difference is censored by its own share, so the observed statistic confounds differential preference with differential attenuation: a severity shift common to both responses manufactures an interaction whenever the two censor it unequally, as unequal distances from the bounds make them, exactly where good stimuli place them. We exhibit the failure inside a pre-registered audit of a frozen pedagogy judge, sealed before the first of its 990 calls. The registered primary endpoint, the effect of a stated learner profile on the judge's scaffolding preference, is null: $+0.085$ points (95\% BCa $[-0.167, +0.353]$, $p = 0.684$). The audit's one nominally significant interaction, $+0.378$ ($p = 0.002$), is not identified as preference: a construction containing zero differential preference reproduces 79 to 85\% of it from the observed severity shift and the scale floor alone. We derive the mechanism in closed form and show that its contribution is measurable from an audit's own ratings.
2608.27309.paper_summary_zh: 審計 LLM 評審通過對比匹配條件來認證偏見，而最強的設計差異則是兩次：在兩個候選回應之間的項內對比，再加上跨一個操控屬性的差異，從一個有限的評分範圍中讀取。我們顯示這個端點在報告它的範圍上並未被識別。雙重差異的每一項都受到自身份額的限制，因此觀察到的統計數據將差異偏好與差異衰減混淆：對於兩個回應來說，當它們不平等地限制時，普遍存在的嚴重性轉變會產生交互作用，正是因為距離邊界的不平等使它們正好位於良好刺激所放置的位置。我們展示了一個在預註冊的審計中失敗的例子，這個審計針對一位凍結的教學評審，在其990次呼叫中的第一次之前密封。註冊的主要端點，即所述學習者檔案對評審的支架偏好的影響，為零：$+0.085$ 分（95\% BCa $[-0.167, +0.353]$，$p = 0.684$）。該審計唯一名義上顯著的交互作用 $+0.378$ ($p = 0.002$) 並未被識別為偏好：一個包含零差異偏好的構造僅從觀察到的嚴重性轉變和評分範圍底部再現了79%到85%的偏好。我們以封閉形式推導出這一機制，並顯示其貢獻可以從審計自身的評分中測量。
